metadata.description: Official MCP servers for ZennoPoster and ZennoDroid

plugins.name: zennoposter-mcp
plugins.description: ZennoPoster: edit ProjectMaker projects, run and monitor tasks, drive the browser. Requires ZennoPoster 7.9.2+ on Windows.

plugins.name: zennodroid-mcp
plugins.description: ZennoDroid: edit projects, run and monitor tasks, control Android devices. Requires ZennoDroid 2.6.1+ on Windows; its servers run on the ZennoPoster ports shifted by +10 (6217 / 6220, API 5309 / 5310).
